prohibitedSemantics: Implement production Workflow or Node state machines, Router, Scheduler, terminal transition, retry or recovery semantics.
Implement the production Verification System, EvidenceGraph or Learning and Feedback runtime.
Connect real model providers, GBrain, swap-kb, microwave-kb or private local assets.
Introduce a second persistence driver, Control API transport, Policy evaluator or isolation authority.
Fallback from node:sqlite, PROCESS_RESTRICTED, loopback HTTP or canonical Policy evaluator without a superseding ADR.
Let CLI/UI read SQLite or import Kernel/persistence internals.
Let Adapter, Worker, Model or test helper create authority DomainEvent, terminal state, PolicyDecision or GateDecision.
Batch-create empty future packages or interfaces that have no Phase 1 consumer and conformance test.
Copy old local Framework source or preserve old paths merely for compatibility.
Upload or add local private data, secrets, Evidence, Workspace or knowledge content.

semanticConstraints: Produce a self-contained Windows-first qualification artifact with pinned runtime.
Release directory and local data root are separated.
Build uses frozen lockfile and pinned actions/downloads.
Generate checksums, SBOM, provenance/attestation where supported.
Packaging spike does not claim production Release readiness.
Run verification from a clean checkout and immutable commit.
Do not remediate failures inside the independent verification pass.
Every skipped, unavailable or inconclusive step is explicit.
Implementation status may become IMPLEMENTED only; VERIFIED requires independent Gate.

requires: A written finding that identifies the missing scope and why the current Contract cannot be satisfied.
New or superseding ADR when an accepted architectural decision changes.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not silently edit outside allowed paths.
Do not reinterpret a denied path as allowed through generated files or scripts.
Do not introduce a fallback implementation.
Do not continue and report success after a scope violation.
